name: engineering-memlog
description: Engineering memory for AI coding agents — a structured cross-project log, a deliberately dumb CLI, and a Claude Code plugin that pairs systematic debugging with bounded recall.

plugins.name: engineering-memlog
plugins.description: Pairs a systematic debugging skill with bounded recall of prior engineering lessons. Reproduces failures, validates matches as hypotheses, continues local diagnosis on a miss, verifies fixes, and includes /recall for explicit searches.
